name: Concept G: Carbon sundiver sail at 3 solar radii
description: Exotic conditional study, docs/analyses/orion-and-sundiver-hybrid.md (issue #71). Starts after unmodelled delivery onto a 5.204 AU aphelion / 3 R_sun perihelion ellipse. Deploys a constant-beta radial sail at perihelion and retains it to infinity for solar v_inf = 300 km/s, without an impulsive kick. Assumed solar reflectivity 0.9, absorptivity 0.1, thermal emissivity 0.8 per face and 0.5 g/m² distributed sail/support mass require ~646 m² for a 1 kg shielded probe, ~1.323 kg total. These combined optical, thermal, structural and mass properties are not demonstrated; bare graphene is not this mirror.

events.notes: Deploy only at q = 3 R_sun, after the inbound coast. Beta includes the bound-arrival energy deficit; ~2.21 g peak radiation acceleration at ~6.99 MW/m². Assumed R=0.9, alpha=0.1, epsilon=0.8 per face imply ~1666 K. Sun-normal sail remains deployed to infinity; finite jettison lowers the final speed. No impulsive delta-v or Orion stage.
